message.elsewhere.return_rift: The Return Rift carries you home.

message.elsewhere.frayed.home_already: It only pulls when you are far from home.
message.elsewhere.trip.arrived: You drifted into %s. A Frayed Wayfinder will take you back once.
message.elsewhere.effigy.wrong_place: It only takes root in the Pale Hollow.
message.elsewhere.selenne.reflection_hin: Her lids are torn. Only blows struck while standing beside a filled water cauldron (a reflection) can hurt her.
item.elsewhere.moon_eye.desc: Use (3 Glimmer): the mob you look at glows for 10 s.
item.elsewhere.moon_eye.trinket: Caster trinket (off hand or hotbar): your spells deal +20% to mobs you marked.
message.elsewhere.trips.on: Accidental trips are on for you. Use /elsewhere trips off to stop them.
message.elsewhere.trips.off: Accidental trips are off for you. Use /elsewhere trips on to allow them again.

gui.elsewhere.atlas.title: Wayfinder Atlas
atlas.elsewhere.found.event.lantern: Lights moved along the candle road
atlas.elsewhere.pale_hollow.riddle: A forest that never finishes setting. Sleep where the pale trees creak.
atlas.elsewhere.pale_hollow.hint1: Dusk that never ends. What moves here only moves when unwatched.
atlas.elsewhere.pale_hollow.hint2: The tuff runs deep and warm in places. The old trunks keep their hearts close.
atlas.elsewhere.petalwind.riddle: Where blossoms fall upward, the wind remembers a name.
atlas.elsewhere.petalwind.hint1: Islands held up by petals and stubbornness. Mind the edges.
atlas.elsewhere.petalwind.hint2: Something sleeps in the eye of the gale. Three gusts might wake it.
atlas.elsewhere.glasswaste.riddle: Sand that rings like a bell. Heat that does not forgive.
atlas.elsewhere.glasswaste.hint1: The sun is a hazard here, not a lamp. Carry shade.
atlas.elsewhere.glasswaste.hint2: Under the dunes, small glassy things listen for footsteps.
atlas.elsewhere.verdigris_sea.riddle: Green copper, green water, a storm that hums.
atlas.elsewhere.verdigris_sea.hint1: Gears wash up on the tide. Someone wound them once.
atlas.elsewhere.verdigris_sea.hint2: When the thunder rolls in from the sea, stay off the metal.
atlas.elsewhere.ironpeak.riddle: The higher you climb, the thinner the welcome.
atlas.elsewhere.ironpeak.hint1: Thin air, cold iron, and clans who count every step up.
atlas.elsewhere.ironpeak.hint2: The summit has a horn. Not everyone who hears it comes back down.
atlas.elsewhere.greenhaze.riddle: A sweet smoke between the leaves. Breathe slowly.
atlas.elsewhere.greenhaze.hint1: The haze settles in the low places. Some creatures like it there.
atlas.elsewhere.greenhaze.hint2: A small, quick nose can find what the eye misses.
atlas.elsewhere.the_hush.hint1: Every sound you make is heard by something.
atlas.elsewhere.the_hush.hint2: The crystals remember the songs. The archivist remembers the rest.
atlas.elsewhere.overworld.title: The Overworld
atlas.elsewhere.overworld.hint1: Home, though some of its shrines and wrecks now have tenants.
atlas.elsewhere.overworld.hint2: Sleep near strange places and you may wake somewhere stranger.
atlas.elsewhere.the_nether.title: The Nether
atlas.elsewhere.the_nether.hint1: Old heat, older grudges. Three thrones stand among the basalt.
atlas.elsewhere.the_nether.hint2: Gold opens some doors here. Not all of them should be opened.
atlas.elsewhere.the_end.title: The End
atlas.elsewhere.the_end.riddle: Past the dragon, the void keeps going.
atlas.elsewhere.the_end.hint1: Far from the central island, something circles a broken halo.
atlas.elsewhere.the_end.hint2: The void is patient. Wear something that remembers the ground.
